summary: The WelcomeStaffAdmin module provides an administrative interface for staff to monitor and manage submitted student employment applications. It features filtering options, data validation, and user interaction tracking through a web-based UI.
purpose: To allow staff administrators to view, filter, and refresh the list of student employment applications, including withdrawn applications, based on selected agency, discipline, and date ranges. It provides validation and error/warning messaging, and displays user information such as last login.

fields.name: EndDate
validation: CustomValidator: EndDate must be after StartDate

workflows.name: View and Filter Employment Applications
steps: Staff admin logs in; last login and timezone are displayed.
Site and Discipline dropdowns are filled based on agency and available options.
Admin sets StartDate and EndDate and may toggle 'Show Withdrawn' checkbox.
Admin clicks 'Refresh View' to update the applications list.
The grid displays filtered applications with details such as Name, Program, Site, Submission date, Status, Withdrawn date, and Email.
Error and warning panels display any data or system issues.
Validation is performed for required fields, date formats, and that EndDate is after StartDate.

business_rules: Default StartDate is today minus three months; EndDate is today.
If EndDate is before StartDate, the form is invalid.
ShowWithdrawn toggles inclusion of withdrawn applications in the view.
The Site and Discipline dropdowns insert an 'All' entry at the top.
validations: StartDate is required and must match a valid date format.
EndDate is required, must be a valid date, and must be after or equal to StartDate.
Site and Discipline selections are required.
calculations: Default date range: StartDate = Today - 3 months; EndDate = Today.
Withdrawn status and date displayed if present.
conditions: Fill discipline and site dropdowns based on current agency and session.
Display panels for error and warning messages if needed.
Show last login panel if available.
system_behavior: Uses AJAX UpdatePanel for partial-page postbacks.
Auto-focus/default button set for form submission.
Grid supports paging (default page size 50) and customized columns.
Dynamic JavaScript variables registered for client-side validation.
Row data binding adds links for names and emails.
exceptions: Error or warning panels triggered if validations fail or data issues occur.
If no data found, grid displays 'No Data' message.
content_gaps: No explicit description of all possible grid columns or full EmploymentApplication entity fields.
Underlying implementation of external dependencies (Date.js, WelcomeStaffAdmin.js, HSPnet.DataLayer.EmploymentApplications) not provided.
Error/warning management details are limited to panel display and are not deeply described.
